items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-09-04
items.q: The bootleggers in New York, Sam Meltzer and Bolentino. I think one of the two issued some of those unissued masters that had never come out on Victor. I don't know if we can ever obtain those.

ctx.x: This is an interview with Bill Russell at Seminar Room 2 in the Harvard Tilton Memorial Library at Tulane University. This is Rio 1, the date is September 4th, 1962.

We'd been talking about some of the, this is Bill Russell again, some of the musicians that I'd interviewed at various times preparing for the book Jazz Man, and other times after that, that we weren't able to talk to because most of them are dead now. We weren't able to interview them for our Jazz Archive directly here. One of them was George Bach K., whom I stopped to see in Philadelphia in 1940, fall of 1940.
